items.title: What Does EQT (EQT) Record Lateral Mean For Its Gas Recovery Plans?
items.summary: EQT (NYSE:EQT) reported completing a record-setting horizontal lateral in the Appalachian Basin and is now testing advanced gas recovery methods. The company is applying secondary and tertiary recovery techniques on the new well to assess how much additional natural gas can be produced. Management is running these tests across EQT's Appalachian footprint to compare recovery efficiency with prior drilling and completion approaches.
